# Probe DOWN movement of the door into the room

    r=action(['DOWN'])

        if n['color'] in ('O','b') and n['boundary'][0][0]<45:

    print(f"DOWN {i+1}: done={res.get('done')} lvl={res.get('level_completed')} changed={res.get('board_changed')} {pos}")
    if res.get('done') or res.get('level_completed') or res.get('game_over'):
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
